purpose: Original decorative crayon illustrations for the Cottonwood Library website.

prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate an original extremely simple hand-drawn crayon spot illustration for Cottonwood Community Library website widgets. Quiet, sweet, slightly funny childhood warmth with the spare expressive simplicity of vintage newspaper comic children, original characters. Think a child's confident little drawing, almost a doodle, NOT a polished storybook illustration. Tiny dot eyes, one small curved smile, a few hair strokes, round heads, small uncomplicated bodies. Wobbly dark graphite wax-pencil outlines, very sparse rough dry-crayon color patches; large mostly unfilled areas. No shading, rendering, gradients, realism, 3D, complex anatomy or detailed clothing. Strict small palette: deep indigo #1b2040 outlines, indigo #4956a7 and pale leaf green #beedae crayon accents; natural minimal pale skin fills if necessary. Meant to sit on the site's off-white #f7f8ff or pale lilac #e3e7ff, but DO NOT draw any backdrop. Genuinely transparent PNG alpha background, including gaps between all objects. Isolated single compact composition, full figures visible, ample transparent margins, readable at 180-240px wide, no text, letters, logos, borders, panel, labels, watermark, opaque white rectangle, paper sheet, checkerboard or cast shadow. The art should feel intentionally underdrawn and SUPER SIMPLE. Scene: exactly two young children sitting cross-legged shoulder to shoulder, leaning slightly toward one shared open indigo book in their laps. One has just three curved hair strokes and a pale green shirt; the other short curly hair and an indigo shirt. A single imperfect short baseline grounds them. No trees, scenery or extra objects. Friendly quiet companionship. Low wide composition.
